text:
morgan: Quick sync — we need to finalize actor/context fields and which events are customer-visible. Product wants minimal payloads for UI; legal wants full provenance. How do we reconcile? 

samir: Proposal: two shapes — minimal and full. Minimal for UI/analytics, full for audit exports and SIEMs. Keep canonical fields the same names.

elaine: agree. Can we do a quick example for token rotation (KMS/BYOK) and RBAC changes? I'm worried about leaking service account internals in customer-visible events. :thinking_face:

samir: Minimal sample (for UI):
```json
{"event_id":"evt_01","time":"2026-03-18T17:12:01Z","action":"key.rotate","status":"success","actor":{"id":"serv_123","type":"service","display_name":"user-facing-key-manager"},"target":{"id":"key_abc","type":"kms_key"}}
```

samir: Full sample (for audit export / SIEM):
```json
{"event_id":"evt_01","time":"2026-03-18T17:12:01Z","action":"key.rotate","status":"success","actor":{"id":"serv_123","type":"service","display_name":"user-facing-key-manager","principal_email":"kms-operator@acme.internal","roles":["kms_manager"]},"target":{"id":"key_abc","type":"kms_key","customer_id":"cust_999"},"request_id":"req_555","kms":{"key_version":"v3","old_key_id":"key_v2"},"source_ip":"10.12.3.4","user_agent":"redwood-runtime/2.1"}
```

ashley: For customer-visible: strip principal_email and source_ip, include actor.display_name and actor.type only. Legal wants a flag to export full versions on request (with controls + audit).

pratik: Naming convention thoughts: use dot-delimited action verbs with nouns, e.g., "key.rotate", "rbac.role.assign". Keep action in present-tense base verb. Avoid past tense. Use a separate "status" field for outcome.

henry: Also add a top-level "visibility":"public|internal|export-only" field so services can assert what gets emitted by default.

morgan: That helps. For RBAC changes, how do we represent before/after? Minimal should show role name and target; full should include diffs.

samir: Example RBAC minimal:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_02","time":"2026-03-18T17:20:12Z","action":"rbac.role.assign","status":"success","actor":{"id":"usr_42","type":"user","display_name":"alexa"},"target":{"id":"team_12","type":"team"},"role":"reader","visibility":"public"}
```

samir: Full RBAC diff:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_02","time":"2026-03-18T17:20:12Z","action":"rbac.role.assign","status":"success","actor":{"id":"usr_42","type":"user","display_name":"alexa","email":"alexa@acme.com"},"target":{"id":"team_12","type":"team"},"role":"reader","role_diff":{"before":[],"after":["reader"]},"request_id":"req_557","visibility":"export-only"}
```

elaine: Important: any PII (email, ip) must be export-only and behind the export control. Default retention shorter for public events.

deploy-bot: note: deployed feature flag event-visibility-guard to staging at 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z :rocket:

ashley: On migration path: 1) enforce new schema at ingest with warnings, 2) 2-week opt-in windows, 3) block-only after opt-out window and customer notif. Also add evals to ensure no downstream consumers break.

pratik: We should publish a sample CSV of customer-visible events for PMs to validate UI consumption. Also add a per-event "schema_version" string.

henry: For KMS integration, emit both "kms.key_rotate.requested" and "kms.key_rotate.completed" with correlated request_id. That helps incident timeline.

morgan: OK — action items:
- samir: write canonical schema doc + minimal/full examples (include redaction rules) — due EOD Fri
- ashley: define export gating and legal checklist — due Mon
- pratik: add schema_version and visibility enums to proto and SDKs — due next Wed
- henry: add correlated event types for KMS flows and update incident playbook — due next Tue

morgan: If no objections, I'll add these to the event-catalog PR. :+1:

securitybot: Reminder: any export-only fields must be flagged in the catalog and reviewed by Compliance before GA.

ashley: no objections from me. :heavy_check_mark:

morgan: Thanks everyone — short follow-up sync tomorrow if needed.
